name: Perlin Surface
description: Seeded gradient Perlin noise as a smooth NURBS control-point surface. Frequency is cycles per model unit; no octave/fractal approximation.

inputs.name: Amplitude
inputs.description: Height multiplier; zero gives a plane

inputs.name: Frequency
inputs.description: Noise cycles per model unit, 0.001 to 10

usageNotes: Connect Surface to Populate Surface UV, Frames to Sphere Base, a radius slider to Sphere Radius. Preview both the surface and spheres if requested. Seed and resolution should use integer-valued controls.

name: Populate Surface UV
description: Repeatable random UV samples on an untrimmed surface; not an equal-area or minimum-distance distribution.

outputs.name: Frames
outputs.description: Local planes for orienting spheres or panels

usageNotes: Count is integer 0..500. Output 1 is a list of surface frames, suitable for Sphere Base. This is random UV sampling, not equal-area or minimum spacing.

name: Bounds Dimensions
description: Live world-axis width, depth and height dimensions. Outputs ordinary curves and outlined text for web previews, plus numeric measurements. Model units are unchanged.

inputs.name: Unit Suffix
inputs.description: Optional label only, e.g. mm; does not convert geometry units

outputs.name: Dimensions
outputs.description: Extension lines, dimension lines and outlined labels

usageNotes: Measure final geometry feeding the existing previews, combining all needed branches into Geometry input. Preview Dimensions output 0, preserving the shelf previews. Numeric outputs are measurements, not geometry. World-axis bounding dimensions; not arbitrary aligned native Rhino annotation objects.
